items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: It was really operated by Texas Guinan's brother -- he was a gangster. ... Texas Guinan at that time was a really big woman in New York.

ctx.x: No. Me? What? Are you kidding? We had some good times around New York.

Then what happened after that? Club Alabam. Then I got another job when the Club Alabam closed; I went into the Chez Paree...Chez Something... It was some woman's name. It was supposed to be her club. It was really operated by Texas Guinan's brother -- he was a gangster.
